spec.description: spec defines the desired state of IBMPowerVSImage

bucket.description: bucket is the Cloud Object Storage bucket name; bucket-name[/optional/folder]

clusterName.description: clusterName is the name of the Cluster this object belongs to.

deletePolicy.description: deletePolicy defines the policy used to identify images to be preserved beyond the lifecycle of associated cluster.

object.description: object is the Cloud Object Storage image filename.

region.description: region is the Cloud Object Storage region.

storageType.description: storageType is the type of storage, storage pool with the most available space will be selected.

workspace.description:
workspace identifies the PowerVS workspace into which the image will be imported.
If omitted, the workspace is inherited from the associated IBMPowerVSCluster.
